guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice_cpu rose from 0.2857 to 7.6934 (+2593%, z=+305), the largest deviation in the digest, with correlated latency-90 (+854%), socket count (3 to 9.1) and mem (+21%) increases, and no other service shows a comparable change. Confidence is not high because the worst traces do not pass through emailservice and no error logs or spans exist to confirm it, though emailservice is a callee of checkoutservice per the service map.

proposed_fix.description: Investigate the CPU consumption of emailservice (runaway loop or hot process), and restart or scale out its replicas while rolling back any recent change; this is non-destructive.
